head: GoaTime combines your tasks, daily plan and time tracking
dek: GoaTime brings personal tasks, projects, daily planning and time tracking together, so you see your next step and where your time goes. It was #38 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It costs $4.99, by Cache Money LLC.
means: If you want to know where your hours actually go, it tracks time next to your to-dos.
todo: Find GoaTime in the App Store.
